parameters.query:
-- Fetch property data from cache or listings.
SELECT
  COALESCE(pc.payload, '{}'::jsonb) AS property_data,
  l.title, l.price, l.currency, l.location, l.property_type,
  l.operation_type, l.bedrooms, l.bathrooms, l.area_m2,
  l.description, l.url
FROM (SELECT $1 AS prop_id) AS input
LEFT JOIN properties_cache pc ON pc.property_id = input.prop_id
LEFT JOIN listings l ON l.listing_hash = input.prop_id OR l.url ILIKE '%' || input.prop_id || '%'
LIMIT 1;

-- Fetch last 20 messages for conversation context.
SELECT direction, sender_type, body, created_at
FROM messages
WHERE conversation_id = $1::uuid
  AND body IS NOT NULL
  AND body != ''
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;

INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender_type, recipient_phone, body, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'outbound', 'ai', $2, $3, $4::jsonb);
